description: Each such source's interpreted schema, as carried, satisfies §3.2's schema-validity gate: every referenced type is defined, every field and argument has a type, no definition repeats a field or argument name, input positions carry input types and output positions output types, and the `query` root operation type is present and is an Object type.
notes: §3.2 gate 5. An absent mutation or subscription root is not gated (§3.3.1 makes them optional); it is a §5.2.1.1 validation failure handled by §5.

tests.description: schema without a query root operation type (§3.3.1)

content.schema: type User { id: ID! name: String }

tests.description: repeated field name in one definition

content.schema: type Query { status: String status: Int }

tests.description: input type in an output position

content.schema:
type Query { a: In }
input In { x: Int }

tests.description: output type in an input position

content.schema:
type Query { a(arg: User): String }
type User { id: ID! }
